maxSeconds.description: The film is at most this long. Seconds.

minSeconds.description: The film is at least this long. Seconds.

maxStatic.description: The picture never holds still for longer than this (`review` measures the whole frame, at most 90 samples of a timeline). Seconds.

endCard.description: The film ends on a held card, measured on the last stretch of the range reviewed; skipped when the range stops short of the end.

minSeconds.description: The film ends on a picture that holds still (and is not blank) for at least this long. Seconds.

loudness.description: Measured on an exported file (`review --file`), after the encode; a timeline has no loudness, so these are skipped for one.

target.description: Integrated loudness the file should have, LUFS (e.g. -14).

tolerance.description: LU the file may be off `target` (default 1.5, the delivery check's).

maxTruePeak.description: The file's true peak stays at or under this, dBTP (e.g. -1).

minSize.description: Smallest caption text, as a share of the film's short side (0.026 is 28 px at 1080). Read from the subtitle tracks of a timeline.

clips.description: Per-clip expectations, checked on a timeline.

appearsBy.description: The clip starts at or before this time: seconds, or a marker id or label (optionally `hook+0.5`), as `marker.list` shows them.

before.description: The clip starts before this other clip starts.

maxStatic.description: The picture does not hold still for longer than this while the clip plays (the whole frame, so a clip under another moving one passes). Seconds.

fail.description: Craft checks that are failures in this project: their warnings count in `requirements.failed` and make `frameshell review` exit 1, unless waived.

check.description: The craft check to waive, as `metrics.craft` names it (`static`, `reading`, `safe-zone`...).

clip.description: Waive only warnings whose time overlaps this clip. Absent: every warning of the check, including those about the whole film.

reason.description: Why the warning is accepted: shown beside the waived warning.
